Core Active Vocabulary (10 items):

bed — the furniture you sleep on. Example: The bed is next to the window.
sofa — a long soft seat for two or more people. Example: The sofa is in front of the TV.
chair — a seat for one person. Example: There are four chairs.
table — furniture with a flat top and legs. Example: The keys are on the table.
wardrobe — a cupboard for clothes. Example: My clothes are in the wardrobe.
lamp — a light you can switch on. Example: The lamp is next to the bed.
shelf — a flat board for putting things on. Example: The books are on the shelf.
door — the part you open to enter a room. Example: Close the door, please.
window — the glass opening in a wall. Example: Open the window, please.
TV — a machine for watching programmes. Example: The TV is in front of the sofa.
Essential Chunks & Functional Collocations:

• Where is the ...?
• It is on the table.
• It is under the bed.
• Next to the door.
• In front of the window.
